derivation: Original brief and tentative exact plan; no golden products, sources or method-conditioned answers.

six_axes.assessment: All original brief/plan material behavior and negative constraints addressed.
Consequential source facts grounded in governing primary context with subject/version/platform/conditions intact.
Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, viable alternatives and relevant history; missing material families recorded.
Valid supported corrections, criticism rejections and tentative-plan retain/change/reject decisions.
Supported draft/criticism meaning survives into the complete final, including conditions and alternatives.
Meaningful feasible validation; executed work distinguished from future proposals and unknown user data.

obligations.name: Disconnected shared edits
obligations.assessment: Support local insertion/reorder, cue text/timing changes, assignments and comments during disconnected rehearsal.

obligations.name: Stable references
obligations.assessment: Preserve cue identity and correct comment/reference association across reorder, insertion and exchanges.

obligations.name: Reconciliation and work preservation
obligations.assessment: Handle incompatible concurrent edits intelligibly without silently discarding useful crew work.

obligations.name: Approved publication
obligations.assessment: Separate editable rehearsal revisions from deliberately approved run sheets; viewers know version and offline state.

obligations.name: Retry/reconnect and recovery
obligations.assessment: Address repeat exchanges, ordering/clock assumptions and app-close/restart persistence boundaries.

obligations.name: Alternatives and integration limits
obligations.assessment: Compare plausible mechanisms/history; team relay allowed, no always-online editor, enterprise account or new chat-product requirement.

validation_expectation: Propose discriminating checks for simultaneous insert/reorder/text edits, comment anchors after structural changes, repeated/interrupted exchange, offline viewing and publication identity. Distinguish actually executed research/checks from future service/application behavior.
evaluation_rules: Use source-supported qualitative dispositions, not citation/answer-length counts.
Material unsupported claims, required omissions, false rejection or preservation loss preclude a full source pass.
A decisive stopped screen leaves every unassessed axis explicit.
Observed evaluator/candidate discovery union is finite, not universal external-world recall.
Unknown local user data may remain unknown; available mechanism research remains required.
